source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary:
In your Shooting phase, once this model has shot, pick 1 enemy unit hit by at least 1 of those attacks. For the rest of the turn, each attack against that enemy unit by friendly models that disembarked this turn from this **TRANSPORT** has its Armour Penetration characteristic improved by 1.

This ability can affect a given enemy unit only once per turn.

reminder.unresolved: Withheld as a class: independent reviews found 4 of 86 sampled reminders of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, above the 2% this reading may ship with.

effects.appliesTo: attacks by friendly models that disembarked from this TRANSPORT this turn against the selected unit

detail.limit: each enemy unit affected once per turn
